verse.verse_1: The Hour has drawn near, and the moon has been cleft asunder.
verse.verse_2: And if they see an Ayah, they turn away and say: "This is magic, Mustamir."
verse.verse_3: They denied and followed their own lusts. And every matter will be settled.
verse.verse_4: And indeed there has come to them news wherein there is Muzdajar.
verse.verse_5: Perfect wisdom, but warners benefit them not.
verse.verse_6: So withdraw from them. The Day that the caller will call (them) to a terrible thing.
verse.verse_7: They will come forth, with humbled eyes from (their) graves as if they were locusts spread abroad,
verse.verse_8: Hastening towards the caller. The disbelievers will say: "This is a hard Day."
verse.verse_9: The people of Nuh denied (their Messenger) before them. They rejected Our servant and said: "A madman!" Wazdujir.
verse.verse_10: Then he invoked his Lord (saying): "I have been overcome, so help (me)!"
verse.verse_11: So, We opened the gates of the heaven with water Munhamir.
verse.verse_12: And We caused springs to gush forth from the earth. So, the waters met for a matter predestined.
verse.verse_13: And We carried him on a (ship) made of planks and nails (Dusur)
verse.verse_14: Floating under Our Eyes, a reward for him who had been rejected!
verse.verse_15: And indeed, We have left this as a sign. Then is there any that will remember
verse.verse_16: Then how (terrible) was My torment and My warnings
verse.verse_17: And We have indeed made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember; then is there anyone who will remember
verse.verse_18: `Ad denied; then how was My torment and My warnings
verse.verse_19: Verily, We sent against them a violently cold (Sarsar) wind on a day of calamity, continuous.
verse.verse_20: Plucking out men as if they were uprooted stems of date palms.
verse.verse_21: Then, how was My torment and My warnings
verse.verse_22: And We have indeed made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember; then is there any that will remember
verse.verse_24: And they said: "A man, alone among us -- shall we follow him Truly, then we should be in error and distress!"
verse.verse_25: "Is it that the Reminder is sent to him alone from among us Nay, he is an insolent liar!"
verse.verse_26: Tomorrow they will come to know who is the liar, the insolent one!
verse.verse_27: Verily, We are sending the she-camel as a test for them. So watch them, and be patient!
verse.verse_28: And inform them that the water is to be shared between (her and) them, each one's right to drink being established (by turns).
verse.verse_29: But they called their comrade and he took (a sword) and killed (her).
verse.verse_30: Then, how was My torment and My warnings
verse.verse_31: Verily, We sent against them a single Sayhah, and they became like straw Al-Muhtazir.
verse.verse_32: And indeed, We have made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember; then is there any that will remember
verse.verse_33: The people of Lut denied the warnings.
verse.verse_34: Verily, We sent against them Hasib (a violent storm of stones), except the family of Lut, them We saved in the last hour of the night,
verse.verse_35: As a favor from Us. Thus do We reward him who gives thanks.
verse.verse_36: And he indeed had warned them of Our punishment, but they doubted the warnings!
verse.verse_37: And they indeed sought to shame his guests. So, We blinded their eyes (saying), "Then taste you My torment and My warnings."
verse.verse_38: And verily, an abiding torment seized them early in the morning.
verse.verse_39: Then taste you My torment and My warnings.
verse.verse_40: And indeed, We have made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember; then is there any that will remember
verse.verse_41: And indeed, warnings came to the people of Fir`awn.
verse.verse_42: (They) denied all Our signs, so We seized them with a punishment of the Almighty, All-Capable.
verse.verse_43: Are your disbelievers better than these Or have you immunity in the Divine Scriptures
verse.verse_44: Or say they: "We are a great multitude, victorious"
verse.verse_45: Their multitude will be put to flight, and they will show their backs.
verse.verse_46: Nay, but the Hour is their appointed time, and the Hour will be more grievous and more bitter.
verse.verse_47: Verily, the criminals are in error and will burn.
verse.verse_48: The Day they will be dragged on their faces into the Fire (it will be said to them): "Taste you the touch of Hell!"
verse.verse_49: Verily, We have created all things with Qadar.
verse.verse_50: And Our commandment is but one as the twinkling of an eye.
verse.verse_51: And indeed, We have destroyed your likes; then is there any that will remember
verse.verse_52: And everything they have done is noted in Az-Zubur.
verse.verse_53: And everything, small and large, is written down.
verse.verse_54: Verily, those who have Taqwa, will be in the midst of Gardens and Rivers.
verse.verse_55: In a seat of truth, near the Muqtadir King.
